title: What if Earth lost its atmosphere for one minute? #shorts
description:
The air above you presses on every square metre with the weight of about ten tonnes. What would happen if it disappeared for just sixty seconds?

The facts: without air there is nothing to scatter sunlight, so the sky turns black and stars show in daylight. Sound cannot travel without air, so the world goes silent. Below roughly 10 hPa even near-freezing water boils, and the evaporation cools the rest so fast that the surface freezes. A person exposed to vacuum stays conscious for only about ten to fifteen seconds.
